name: deepseek-harness-augmented-dsh-plugins
description: dsh plugins pre-installed in the image's seed `web` profile (scripts/install-dsh-plugins.mjs). Exact pins, bumped by Renovate. `dshPlugins.enabled` lists the ones selected by default; the others are installed but switched off (enable them from the Plugins page). Not installed with npm: the dependencies block only exists so Renovate can track the pins.
